meta_title: GEO Compass — Generative Engine Optimization for everyone
meta_description: GEO Compass tracks your visibility in AI answers every day — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral — without an agency budget.
meta_og_alt: GEO Compass — visibility tracking in AI answers
hero_explainer: GEO, or Generative Engine Optimization, is the craft of getting cited by generative AI like ChatGPT or Mistral when they answer your customers.
feature_cost_body: A single OpenRouter connection, shared across all users and funded by donations — no subscription.
feature_cost_detail: GEO Compass runs collaboratively: one OpenRouter connection, shared across every user and funded by donations. Your prompts are replayed every day on every engine, and you see what matters — your rank, your mentions, your competitors — with no subscription.
feature_daily_body: Results are recomputed every day at 2am. Open the dashboard, or get them straight in your inbox by email.
feature_daily_visual: Visual coming soon — dashboard, daily ranking
feature_history_body: Every run is kept: you measure trends, not a snapshot.
feature_history_visual: Visual coming soon — History screen (mentions over time)
feature_mentions_body: By engine — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral — see which brands are cited for your prompts, and how often.
feature_mentions_detail: For every prompt, we identify the brands cited by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Mistral, and count how often. You see who dominates your category in AI answers, engine by engine, and where you stand.
donations_body: Querying the models every day has a real cost. GEO Compass stays free and open: donations fund the runs.
donations_shared_body: Donations feed a shared pool that pays for the daily runs for everyone.
donations_ownkey_body: Want to be self-sufficient? Plug in your own OpenRouter key and only pay for your own runs.
geo_lead: GEO — Generative Engine Optimization — is ranking inside AI answers. When a customer asks ChatGPT or Mistral which tool to choose, two or three brands get cited. There is no second page.
geo_point_1_body: Your prompts are replayed every day on every engine. We count the mentions.
geo_point_2_body: The ranking shows your position against other brands in your category.
geo_point_3_title: Track the effect of your actions
geo_point_3_body: History tells you whether what you published changed anything.
